scope: Current local XOCE website visual identity, separate from native app UI standards.
status: Approved tactile homepage concept implemented locally across the website; verification reported separately. All publication gates remain.

name.treatment: Outlined Fira Sans Condensed ExtraBold XOCE wordmark, monochrome and theme-aware; matching blue X favicon.

typography.delivery: Self-hosted Latin/Latin Extended WOFF exports, font-display swap
typography.legacy_assets: Inter and Space Grotesk are retained historical assets.

palette.treatment: Cool silver/graphite materials, fine edge highlights, contact shadows and blue interaction light. Product stages are shared graphite surfaces; documentation retains an opaque reading surface.

compositions.home: Compact introduction, direct app/setup actions and a single graphite stage with actual Time 2/Dynamic and Round 2/Halftone frames. Shared labelled lower rail. Material watchface tiles, watch-app rows and distinct phone plugin follow.
compositions.catalogue: Paired image-led watchface comparisons, compact watch-app rows beside their group introduction, and a separate Czech weather phone-plugin section. Six consumer products; libraries remain in the developer path.
compositions.product: Purpose, official device or plugin icon, compatibility and installation lead. A product-specific native capture or phone-settings preview illustrates features, followed by relevant connections, the full gallery and setup/support.
compositions.about: Compact two-column opening, project rationale grounded in replaceable apps and interface exploration, platform row and readable stage progression, with one understated Phone-plan paragraph and plain link.
compositions.docs: A sole dense article surface with quiet sidebar and contents rails; native collapsed mobile disclosures.

device_presentation.kind: Official Pebble Appstore Time 2 and Round 2 frames around unmodified native emulator captures
device_presentation.native_captures: Unchanged bytes and 200:228 aspect ratio; matte black letterboxing avoids stretching in the taller aperture. Provenance remains in docs/asset-provenance.json.
device_presentation.claims: Native emulator screens composited with an official device frame; not a photograph of the running apps or physical-watch verification.
device_presentation.compact_views: Direct native screen captures remain useful for compact lists and documentation.
device_presentation.interaction: Home names both watchfaces and models without cycling; product pages use native radio controls for Time 2/Round 2 selection. Compact feature and workflow illustrations use direct native captures.
device_presentation.licence_status: No permissive licence verified for the official frame; source-provided asset included for local review, with no additional licence granted.

artwork.source: Original geometric vector artwork authored for the XOCE website.
artwork.motion: None; historical background planes are not rendered.

interaction.appearance: System, Light and Dark; explicit choices saved in the browser.
interaction.controls: Immediate pressed states; fine-pointer controls can depress 1px. Touch controls remain stationary. Keyboard focus stays explicit.
interaction.motion: No idle, pointer-following or automatic showcase animation; reduced motion respected.
interaction.transparency: Opaque fallbacks for unsupported backdrop filtering and reduced transparency.
interaction.focus: Ordinary visits leave inputs unfocused; explicit Search focuses its field.
interaction.without_javascript: Navigation, article reading, native disclosures, available-software catalogue and watch preview remain usable; search and theme controls enhance the static base.

design_references.observation: Physical interaction, material hierarchy and immediate feedback; no perspective tilt.
Author’s task-based explanations and useful visible controls.
Distinct product personality and concrete presentation.
Material and control discipline; reference only, no copied assets.

preserved: Exact release links, licences and publication gates
Unmodified native screenshots and official device frame bytes
Platform-specific app interfaces and historical assets
validation: Current browser proof belongs in ignored build/qa/tactile-identity-20261114; historical reports retain their original scope.

store_family.nativeScreens: Unmodified emulator captures; native apps and controls are unchanged.

store_family.icons: One black glyph on a transparent background, binary alpha; icon_tintable=true in Store listing. Website foreground adapts to theme.
